def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # Phase A: bars from band gaps, drawn top-to-bottom; each bar extends up from its band until hitting existing colored cells
    bandinfo=[]
    for i in range(H):
        row=g[i]
        maxj=max(j for j in range(W) if row[j]!=0)
        gaps=[j for j in range(maxj+1) if row[j]==0 and j>=1 and j+1<W and row[j-1]!=0 and row[j-1]==row[j+1]]
        if gaps: bandinfo.append((i,gaps))
    for i,(ib,gaps) in enumerate(bandinfo):
        for j in gaps:
            c=g[i][j-1]
            out[ib][j]=c
            r=ib-1
            while r>=0 and out[r][j]==0:   # extend up through background
                out[r][j]=c
                r-=1
    # Phase B: stubs (maximal vertical runs) grow upward through background until adjacent to a differently-colored cell
    for j in range(W):
        i=H-2
        while i>=0:
            if out[i][j]!=0: break
            i-=1
        if i<0: continue
        c=out[i][j]; t=i
        while t+1<H and out[t+1][j]==c: t+=1
        # nearest colored cell above run top
        s=i-1
        while s-1>=0 and out[s-1][j]==0: s-=1
        if s>=0 and out[s][j]!=c:
            s2=i-1
            while s2-1>=0 and out[s2-1][j]==0:
                out[s2][j]=c; s2-=1
        i+=1
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    bandinfo=[]
    for i in range(H):
        row=g[i]
        nz=[j for j in range(W) if row[j]!=0]
        if not nz: continue
        maxj=max(nz)
        gaps=[j for j in range(maxj+1) if row[j]==0 and j>=1 and j+1<W and row[j-1]!=0 and row[j-1]==row[j+1]]
        if gaps: bandinfo.append((i,gaps))
    for ib,gaps in bandinfo:
        for j in gaps:
            c=g[ib][j-1]
            out[ib][j]=c
            r=ib-1
            while r>=0 and out[r][j]==0:
                out[r][j]=c; r-=1
    for j in range(W):
        i=H-2
        while i>=0:
            if out[i][j]!=0: break
            i-=1
        if i<0: continue
        c=out[i][j]; t=i
        while t+1<H and out[t+1][j]==c: t+=1
        s=i-1
        while s-1>=0 and out[s-1][j]==0: s-=1
        if s>=0 and out[s][j]!=c:
            s2=i-1
            while s2-1>=0 and out[s2-1][j]==0:
                out[s2][j]=c; s2-=1
        i+=1
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    orig=[r[:] for r in g]; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    bandinfo=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(orig):
        nz=[j for j in range(W) if row[j]!=0]
        if not nz: continue
        maxj=max(nz)
        gaps=[j for j in range(maxj+1) if row[j]==0 and j>=1 and j+1<W and row[j-1]!=0 and row[j-1]==row[j+1]]
        if gaps: bandinfo.append((i,gaps))
    for ib,gaps in bandinfo:
        for j in gaps:
            c=orig[ib][j-1]
            out[ib][j]=c
            r=ib-1
            while r>=0 and out[r][j]==0:
                out[r][j]=c; r-=1
    # stubs computed from ORIGINAL input runs
    for j in range(W):
        i=H-2
        while i>=0:
            if orig[i][j]!=0: break
            i-=1
        if i<0: continue
        c=orig[i][j]; t=i
        while t+1<H and orig[t+1][j]==c: t+=1
        s=i-1
        while s-1>=0 and orig[s-1][j]==0: s-=1
        if s>=0 and out[s][j]!=c:   # extend through zeros in OUT until hitting different color
            s2=i-1
            while s2-1>=0 and out[s2-1][j]==0:
                out[s2][j]=c; s2-=1
    return out
